findings.value: Booked, paid cider tastings in the shop on Fridays and Saturdays, 6.30pm to 8pm, offered as public or private sessions. Adults only (over 18s).

evidence.quote: Out tastings are available to book every Friday & Saturday, and always run from 6:30pm, to 8pm.
This event involves alcohol, so is strictly for over 18's only.
